blocks.html: Combustible framing shall be a minimum of 2 inches (51 mm), but shall not be less than the distance specified in Sections 2111 and 2113 and the New York City Mechanical Code, from flues, chimneys and fireplaces, and 6 inches (152 mm) away from flue openings.
